method: Three sequential ephemeral Codex evaluations. Each evaluator ran the current Guion/Python acceptance case, inspected the implementations and frozen timing data, then selected a language for a related task.
limitations: The study is exploratory and unblinded; the evaluators could inspect the repository implementations and existing measurement data.
The evaluators received the frozen nine-task timing file, which predates the immutable-text-storage change, so the unchanged choice count cannot be attributed to this optimization.
